note: git worktree move breaks cached test binaries, because cargo bakes ABSOLUTE paths into them via env-bang macros. After renaming a worktree directory, test binaries already in target/ still point at the OLD path and fail on files that no longer exist, which looks like a broken test rather than a stale cache. Hit for real during The Grain: the worktree was renamed from the-illumination to the-grain after a campaign pivot and an implementer had to touch source files to force rebuilds before the suite would run. So: prefer naming a campaign worktree correctly at git worktree add time, and if you do move one, expect a forced rebuild rather than a warm target. Worth knowing before make prewarm, whose whole value is a warm target that a later move silently invalidates.
